title: Free TailAdmin Template Your AI Agent Can Rebuild For You
description:
You ask an agent for a dashboard and it hands you a spreadsheet 😅

TailAdmin is a free HTML admin template on GitHub. Sidebar, charts, tables, login forms, dark mode, all already in there 🔥

The trick: download it and give the folder to your agent. It rebuilds the whole thing around your project, your nav, your data, you brand colors ✨

Search GitHub for TailAdmin

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
